messages:
Maya (people-ops): Hey team — quick scheduling bump for Thurs 9:00am PT panel. One panelist (Alex) has a calendar conflict and needs to swap. Can Samir or Elena cover? If neither, Priya offered to be backup. Also two quick operational q's:

Jordan (eng): @Maya I can cover if needed but prefer Samir for the system-design portion. +1 to adding a buffer between rounds. For debriefs — please leave short bullets in the doc beforehand (TL;DR + 1-2 lines per rubric area).

Priya (interviewer): I can be backup but FYI I'm +8 timezone; 9am PT is doable this week. Quick rubric question: are we using 40/35/25 split (design/implementation/product) or the older 50/30/20?

Maya (people-ops): Good question — Jordan / hiring manager to confirm weights. My leaning is 40/35/25 but will follow your direction. Also, propose a 10-minute buffer between adjacent candidate rounds to avoid overruns and let interviewers drop notes. Thoughts?

Elena (hiring-manager): I can step in if Samir can't. Agree on the 10-min buffer. Also — candidate requested no recordings last time; can we confirm recording policy for this one?

Samir (interviewer): I can cover but I might be ~5–10 min late coming from another meeting. If I cover, I'll leave bullets in the doc pre-debrief. What Zoom link are we using? And recording allowed?

recruiter-bot: Candidate doc + resume: https://recruiting.example/candidates/12345 — candidate note: prefers no recording.

Maya (people-ops): Thanks — important: DO NOT record per candidate request. Please add bullets in the doc before the synchronous debrief: 1-2 lines per rubric area + short overall recommendation (yes/maybe/no). I'll add the 10-min buffer to the calendar and update invites.

Jordan (eng): Confirm rubric weights: 40% system-design, 35% implementation, 25% product-sense. Priya as backup is fine. I'll also ping the eng team for any quick context or PR links the interviewers might want to glance at beforehand (CR ping).

Priya (interviewer): Got it — I'll accept the invite and block the extra 10 mins. Please add the doc link in the invite so I can drop notes pre-call.

Maya (people-ops): Will do. Quick calendar snippet I'm adding to invites:

```
Thu 9:00am PT — Frontend ICN panel (10m buffer after)
Zoom: link in invite
Recording: DISABLED (candidate request)
Notes: add 1-2 line bullets per rubric area in shared doc before debrief
```

Maya (people-ops): Updated invites + doc link here: https://docs.example.com/debriefs/rdw-frontend-icn-12345 — removed recording flag. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Maya (people-ops) (follow-up): Samir confirmed covering the slot. Priya will be backup. Jordan — if you want any quick PRs or repo pointers included in the invite, drop them and I'll attach.

Jordan (eng): I'll add a CR link and a 2-line summary in the invite. Thanks all.

Samir (interviewer): I've added my initials in the doc and will leave bullets after the interview. Thanks.

Priya (interviewer): All set on my end.

Maya (people-ops): Great — closing the loop. Removed recording, added buffer, Samir covering, Priya backup, doc updated. :white_check_mark:
